question: The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 was hosted by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup** is a biennial international football tournament for female players under the age of** 17**, organized by FIFA.
 
• The** 2022 edition** of the tournament was originally scheduled to be hosted by** India** from **November 2 to 21, 2022,** but due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it was postponed to** 2023.**
 
• This will be the first time that India will host a **FIFA women's tournament,** and it will also be the first time that the** U-17 Women's World Cup** will be held in India.
 
• India was awarded the **hosting rights** of the tournament in **2019**, beating out competition from other countries like **South Africa, Korea Republic, and New Zealand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** 2022**, **Morocco, Tanzania**, and the host nation, India, made their **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup** debuts.
 
• **Sixteen teams** made it to the championship round. 
 
• Having won their first championship in **2018, Spain** was the **reigning champion**.
 
 
• They were able to** hold onto** the title.
